intro.text: A soldier of the Kholinar Wall Guard, a lighteyes of the tenth dahn, or 'tenner'.

items.text: During the siege of Kholinar, Ved served in Platoon Seven, Squad Two of the Wall Guard, whose members readily took Kaladin in as their sixth man. They patrolled the inside of the city wall and guarded grain until Velalant's troops came for it, and Ved and Beard stood together on the wall with pikes to fend off a sortie by the Fused.

Ved and his squad went with Azure and Kaladin to see how Azure was feeding the Wall Guard, and he was astonished to learn that Kaladin was a Knight Radiant. Having lost their captain, the squad followed Kaladin and Elhokar into the palace in the battle for Kholinar.
